mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.name, p.code, p.type, p.parent_id AS parentId, p.path, p.icon, p.back_url AS backUrl, p.sort, p.create_date AS createDate, p.create_time AS createTime, p.update_date AS updateDate, p.update_time AS updateTime FROM admin_role ar INNER JOIN role r ON ar.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN role_permission rp ON r.id = rp.role_id INNER JOIN permission p ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE ar.admin_id = #{adminId} AND r.is_disabled = 0 ORDER BY p.sort ASC, p.id ASC
